# GEO知识全书 / GEO Encyclopedia

> Generative Engine Optimization（生成式引擎优化）——让品牌在AI时代被AI主动推荐和引用的完整知识体系。涵盖45篇深度文章、9大章节、100个知识树叶，从基础概念到实战案例，系统掌握GEO方法论。
>
> The complete knowledge system for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — helping brands get recommended and cited by AI. 45 in-depth articles across 9 chapters, from fundamentals to real-world case studies.
